name: Brand rules
observations: Edits are 45 seconds max; cut every pause longer than half a second
No filler words (um, uh) in the edit or the captions

Default caption style is Yellow Serif Kinetic; the older word-by-word yellow captions (reel skill: 3 words per line, the spoken word highlighted in yellow #FFD400) are used only when the owner asks for them

Caption style: Yellow Serif Kinetic (skill yellow-serif): white heavy serif captions, key words warm yellow #FBC238, motions typing / pop / burst / shine / flash, near-black #08090B backgrounds; guide in .claude/skills/yellow-serif/GUIDE.md
Cover text: 3 words max, all caps, the last word in yellow #FFD400
Titles: under 60 characters, plain and specific, no clickbait
Voice: direct and friendly, short sentences, plain words, the way the owner talks
Channel topics: AI agents, Claude Code, building in public

Sermon highlights: never show the slides from the original RAW livestream (no slide half, no split-screen slide cards, no full-screen slide stills). Use only the speaker angle: a vertical 9:16 crop of the speaker from the stage camera (the right half of the 1920x1080 livestream frame, the strip at y 297-837), framed from the head to just below the top of the podium and kept centred on the speaker as he or she moves. Everything else stays as before: phone B-roll cutaways, motion graphics, Yellow Serif Kinetic captions, music and transitions continue as usual.

Motion: every edit is animation-heavy. All on-screen text animates in (no static text cards), and there is at least one motion-graphic element (kinetic title, animated lower-third, animated shape or icon, animated transition) every 10 seconds of runtime.

Post captions (YouTube descriptions, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, pinned comment) never include a credit line with the speaker's name or the sermon / series title (e.g. no "Rev Damien Chua ·《认识神的声音》"). The caption is the message only, plus hashtags.
Write percentages as numbers with % (e.g. 100%), never as 巴仙 (e.g. not 一百巴仙), in captions, titles and on-screen text, even when the interpreter says 巴仙.

Posting: every finished clip goes to Facebook, Instagram and YouTube Shorts at the same time with one Approve & post; TikTok is posted by hand. The owner picks one thumbnail and one caption in the posting overview and that choice is used on every platform.

Board naming: when a clip's video, thumbnail and caption are all ready, its task is called 'Final · <clip title>' (never 'Thumbnail · …' or 'Captions · …'), so the owner knows it is ready to post. The app also marks such tasks with a green ✓ Final tag.

Sound effects: every video gets real CC0 sound effects from the sfx skill (found with the Openverse API), one for each designed move and hit, each sound's loudest moment on the exact frame of its motion; never synthesized beeps, never sound on plain cuts or karaoke words.

name: Lessons
observations: [Social · for Shop, Creative] When a caption is made punchier or more motivating, keep every hedge and condition the speaker used (常常/often, 如果/if, 若是) and check each rewritten line against its captions.srt line before the brand check. On World FM or God FM, the punchy rewrite dropped 常常 twice (不是你选的, 祂的智慧很不一样), and the brand-checker had to restore both.

[Shop · for Social, Scripts] Write post copy in the relay post.md layout from the first draft: Plan, YouTube Shorts, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and Pinned comment, with 2-3 options each and at most 3/5/3/4 hashtags (YouTube/Instagram/Facebook/TikTok). Never take a place or date tag from a folder name. World FM v1 was one caption with 15 hashtags and "10/25 PJ" (only a folder name), and it had to be fully rewritten.

[Creative · for Social, Scripts] For sermon covers, use the interpreter's own Chinese words on two rows, with the answer row in gold (white 世界的频道 over gold 天国的频道), placed over the chest (y about 820-1180) and well below the face (y about 230-560). The owner picked this layout from 4 options and approved it with no corrections.

[Creative · for Creative] Before planning a Poster Kinetic cover in a follow-up run, check the allow list. If the pixel tool is the only renderer allowed, it can't slant or extrude text, gives one colour per row and puts each space-separated word on its own row. So write at most 2 short rows, one colour each, and no mixed-colour hero line like "World FM or God FM?".

[Social · for Social, Creative] Write 2-3 caption options in post.md under '## Captions', each with a 'Title:' line and a caption that works on Facebook, Instagram and YouTube as is: the owner picks one and it goes everywhere, so never split one idea across platform sections.
[Social · for Social] No file paths, 'Video:' or 'For Facebook…' notes inside post.md options: they ended up as the YouTube title and description on the damien-1025 clip.

[Creative · for Creative] One owner per job: the clip-editor delivers one captioned video and one cover.jpg per clip; the thumbnail-designer only steps in when the brand-checker fails a cover or the owner asks for options. Duplicate covers and caption versions confused the review.
[Creative · for Creative, Social] Keep posted files next to post.md and working files in work/, so the posting overview finds the right video and thumbnail.

name: Pong+Gospel · Brand rules
observations: Follow the main "Brand rules" only for what is not set here, and never use the main channel's name, logo, slogans or hashtags for Pong+Gospel.

Never cut the talk (owner, 2026-10-27): keep every sentence Pong says, in order. Remove only pauses, filler sounds (um, ah, ohh, 呃, 啊) and false starts (a line he stops and says again: delete the failed try, keep the full one). This replaces the main rules' 45-second maximum: the length is the whole talk without its pauses.

Editing style (owner, 2026-10-27): Poster Kinetic (poster-kinetic skill) with motion graphics and word animation, sermon-moments only where the words earn it, and real CC0 sound effects from the sfx skill on every designed move and hit. Keep it lively and professional with zoom in / zoom out: alternate a wide and a tight framing at the pause cuts, punch-ins on the hero words. Frame so the captions sit below his chin.

Footage arrives in Google Drive W:/My Drive/PONG/x EDIT/<MMDD>/ (a folder like '1107 08' holds two posting dates, one talk per date). Finished weeks sit in W:/My Drive/PONG/<MMDD>/ as <MMDD>.mp4, <MMDD>.txt (the spoken lines), <MMDD>_<title>.txt (the post), <MMDD>_<title>.jpg and _9x16.jpg covers.
Only Pong's own voice (owner, 2026-10-27): cut crew talk, slates and anyone else speaking before, during or after the take.

Soft background music under the voice on every video (owner, 2026-10-27): a gentle CC0 instrumental (piano or pads, no beat), ducked about 21 dB under his voice while he speaks, with a short tail after the last word.
